reviewMethod: Codex drafting followed by a separate agent editorial review against complete archived source; not independent legal review.

headings.title: Conduct constituting prostitution
headings.reviewNote: Includes engagement, offer or agreement and value received by any person, not necessarily the actor.

headings.title: Offense classification, HIV knowledge, and condom use
headings.reviewNote: Source excludes condom use as a defense; title should not suggest that such a defense is available.

headings.title: Meaning of HIV
headings.reviewNote: Definition topic only, no added medical claim.

headings.title: Treatment programs and sentencing options
headings.reviewNote: Distinguishes discretionary misdemeanor plea/verdict relief from felony prohibition, and possible sentence consideration after treatment.

headings.title: Protections and services for persons under eighteen
headings.reviewNote: Includes no adult certification/delinquency adjudication for this offense, abuse-victim classification, mandatory reporting and investigative assistance.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Value exchange, HIV-based classification and condom defense exclusion, differing treatment consequences, and under-eighteen protections reviewed; title avoids suggesting a condom defense exists. This is not independent legal review.

headings.title: Conduct constituting patronizing prostitution
headings.reviewNote: Read all three alternatives, including prior understanding, agreement and solicitation; no actual completed sexual conduct requirement invented.

headings.title: Belief that the patronized person was an adult
headings.reviewNote: Names the rejected age-belief defense as a topic rather than deciding individual guilt.

headings.title: Patronized person’s age and offense classification
headings.reviewNote: Relevant age is that of the person patronized, not of the defendant.

headings.title: Patronizing persons fifteen or younger; additional prosecutions
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies whose age governs and preserves the additional-offense portion.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Exact 2026 version has class E base offense; patronized persons ages and age-belief defense exclusion distinguished from actors ages and additional prosecutions. This is not independent legal review.

headings.title: Conduct constituting first-degree promotion of prostitution
headings.reviewNote: Includes compulsion, under-sixteen age and interactive-computer-service alternatives with definition; not only coercive conduct.

headings.title: Meaning of compelling a person
headings.reviewNote: Read force, incapacitating substances and withholding/threatened withholding from drug-dependent person.

headings.title: First-degree promotion classifications and prison terms
headings.reviewNote: Preserves distinct class B, class A reckless-disregard trafficking enhancement and under-sixteen statutory prison term.

headings.title: Civil recovery for specified computer-service violations
headings.reviewNote: Limited to referenced subdivisions, includes damages and reasonable attorney fees; not blanket private action for every promotion offense.

headings.title: Restitution for specified computer-service convictions
headings.reviewNote: Keeps conjunction and exact statutory references as supplied; no silent conversion of and to or.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Compulsion, under-sixteen and computer-service alternatives, graded penalties, civil cause, and restitution checked; original and conjunction in subsection 5 retained. This is not independent legal review.

headings.title: Conduct constituting second-degree promotion of prostitution
headings.reviewNote: Includes managing/owning two-or-more-person enterprise or promoting person sixteen/seventeen; read annotation distinguishing own prostitution.

headings.title: Second-degree promotion offense classification
headings.reviewNote: Classification topic only.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Enterprise and age alternatives read with Fredrickson own-prostitution annotation; no implication that acting as a prostitute alone constitutes promotion. This is not independent legal review.

headings.title: Conduct constituting third-degree promotion of prostitution
headings.reviewNote: Read all six knowing assistance, procurement, premises, operation, proceeds and facilitation alternatives.

headings.title: Third-degree promotion offense classification
headings.reviewNote: Classification topic only, no added sentence.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: All six knowing promotion alternatives and class E felony checked. This is not independent legal review.

headings.title: Premises regularly used for prohibited prostitution as a nuisance
headings.reviewNote: Preserves regular-use and prohibited-activity limits.

headings.title: Nuisance suits and restrictions on premises use
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorized prosecutors, equitable relief, owner knowledge and discretionary one-year maximum closure.

headings.title: Nuisance defendants and scope of injunctions
headings.reviewNote: Injunction may cover any prostitution activity within the courts jurisdiction, not only assistance to the nuisance.

headings.title: Appeals from nuisance judgments
headings.reviewNote: Civil appeal route, no invented deadline.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Regular-use nuisance, owner knowledge, one-year occupation restraint, and wider jurisdictional injunction scope checked; third title broadened to avoid limiting injunctions to assisting the nuisance. This is not independent legal review.

headings.title: Conduct constituting promotion of travel for prostitution
headings.reviewNote: Includes knowing sale or offer of travel services including/facilitating such travel and exact definition cross-reference.

headings.title: Travel-promotion offense classification
headings.reviewNote: Classification topic only.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Knowing sale/offer of travel services tied to statutory prostitution definition checked. This is not independent legal review.

headings.title: Prohibited travel services, offers, and promotion
headings.reviewNote: Read promotion and all commercial-sex/contact/escort alternatives; no narrowing to completed travel.

headings.title: Advertisements creating a rebuttable presumption
headings.reviewNote: Preserves rebuttable status and specified words or imagery rather than claiming automatic guilt.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Travel agency/operator scope and listed commercial-sex activities read; advertising presumption remains rebuttable. This is not independent legal review.

headings.title: Prohibited travel offerings that facilitate prostitution
headings.reviewNote: Includes travel agencies and charter operators, selling/advertising/offering services/packages/activities.

headings.title: Corporate revocation and possible account freezes
headings.reviewNote: Distinguishes mandatory articles revocation from discretionary freeze in the proceeding.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Prohibited facilitation, mandatory incorporation revocation, discretionary account freeze, and 2006 effective note checked. This is not independent legal review.
